title: Marketing channel selection
description: Channel choices based on audience evidence and tested with a small trial.

sources.title: UK Government Communication Service, Campaign lifecycle

rules.instruction: Compare candidate channels on the audience reached, expected action, production effort and measurement limits. Record the evidence behind each choice.
rules.verification: Check that the plan gives each selected channel a role in the campaign and cites the evidence for it.

rules.instruction: For each selected channel, plan a small trial whose result could change the choice.
rules.verification: Check that the plan names, for each selected channel, the trial, its success measure and the decision it could change.
